title: Storage Genie
description:
Storage Genie brings a new level of convenience to your self storage experience by granting you seamless, hands-free access to your facility. Simply drive up to the gate, and it will open like magic! No need to remove your phone from your pocket or search for an app. Simplify your self storage experience with Storage Genie. Download now and enjoy the magic!

Key App Features:

• Hands-Free Access: Enter and exit the property, open doors, gates, or elevators without touching your phone (enable location services in settings for this feature).
• Easy Payments: Conveniently pay your self storage rent directly from your mobile device.
• Facility Communication: Effortlessly call or email your self storage facility.
• Activity Tracking: View your activity logs for your self storage property.
• Facility Search: Locate nearby self storage facilities with ease.

*Available at select self storage facilities, contact your facility to learn more.
